<section class="lx-glossary-group" id="glossary-symbols" aria-labelledby="glossary-heading-symbols">
<h2 id="glossary-heading-symbols">Numbers and symbols</h2>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="gitignore" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-gitignore">
<h3 id="glossary-name-gitignore"><a href="#gitignore">.gitignore</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A file listing names and folders, such as keys and large raw data, that git add skips while they are untracked; it does not remove files already committed.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="k08-git-notebooks.html">K8</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="confidence-interval" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-confidence-interval">
<h3 id="glossary-name-confidence-interval"><a href="#confidence-interval">95% confidence interval</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A range worked out from the data by a method that, over many repeated samples, would contain the true value 95 times in 100.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="m14-did-it-work.html">M14</a></p>
</article>
</section>
<section class="lx-glossary-group" id="glossary-a" aria-labelledby="glossary-heading-a">
<h2 id="glossary-heading-a">A</h2>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="absolute-reference" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-absolute-reference">
<h3 id="glossary-name-absolute-reference"><a href="#absolute-reference">Absolute reference</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A spreadsheet address with $ signs, such as $E$1, that stays the same when a formula is copied to other cells.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="k07-spreadsheets.html">K7</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="absorption-chiller" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-absorption-chiller">
<h3 id="glossary-name-absorption-chiller"><a href="#absorption-chiller">Absorption chiller</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A chiller driven by heat, such as steam or hot water, instead of an electric compressor; it uses a salt solution that absorbs and releases a refrigerant.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="cf5-drawing-the-boundary.html">CF5</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="ac-power-flow" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-ac-power-flow">
<h3 id="glossary-name-ac-power-flow"><a href="#ac-power-flow">AC power flow (AC check)</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A calculation of a network&#x27;s voltages, currents and reactive power as well as its MW, from the alternating-current equations; it shows what a DC power flow or a first estimate leaves out.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="a17-physical-feasibility.html">A17</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="additionality" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-additionality">
<h3 id="glossary-name-additionality"><a href="#additionality">Additionality</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">Whether a purchase brings new clean generation that would not have been built otherwise, rather than claiming output that existed anyway.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="a16-hydrogen-ptx.html">A16</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="afue" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-afue">
<h3 id="glossary-name-afue"><a href="#afue">AFUE (annual fuel utilization efficiency)</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">The share of a furnace&#x27;s fuel energy that leaves the furnace as heat over a heating season, under a standard test that leaves out duct losses and the fan&#x27;s electricity.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="f03-energy-services.html">F3</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="agent-based-model" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-agent-based-model">
<h3 id="glossary-name-agent-based-model"><a href="#agent-based-model">Agent-based model</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A simulation in which many decision-makers, such as farmers or households, each follow their own rules, so that the system&#x27;s behavior comes out of their choices.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="ck-r-defend-revise.html">CK-R</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="aggregator" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-aggregator">
<h3 id="glossary-name-aggregator"><a href="#aggregator">Aggregator</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A company that enrolls many customers&#x27; devices, offers their combined response to a grid operator or utility, and shares the payment with the owners.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="a07-flexible-demand.html">A7</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="alkaline-electrolyzer" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-alkaline-electrolyzer">
<h3 id="glossary-name-alkaline-electrolyzer"><a href="#alkaline-electrolyzer">Alkaline electrolyzer</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">An electrolyzer that uses an alkaline liquid electrolyte to carry ions between its electrodes, with operating limits that depend on the equipment design.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="a16-hydrogen-ptx.html">A16</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="ancillary-services" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-ancillary-services">
<h3 id="glossary-name-ancillary-services"><a href="#ancillary-services">Ancillary services</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">Services besides energy that keep the grid steady, such as reserves and frequency regulation; grid operators buy them separately from energy.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="cf5-drawing-the-boundary.html">CF5</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="annualized-capital-cost" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-annualized-capital-cost">
<h3 id="glossary-name-annualized-capital-cost"><a href="#annualized-capital-cost">Annualized capital cost</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A building cost spread into equal yearly amounts over the equipment&#x27;s life, with interest, so it can be set against a year&#x27;s revenue.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="cf4-existing-reactors-hydrogen.html">CF4</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="annuity-factor" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-annuity-factor">
<h3 id="glossary-name-annuity-factor"><a href="#annuity-factor">Annuity factor</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">What one dollar paid every year for a number of years is worth today, once each dollar is discounted.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="k03-discounting.html">K3</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="anticipation-effect" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-anticipation-effect">
<h3 id="glossary-name-anticipation-effect"><a href="#anticipation-effect">Anticipation</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">When people change their behavior before a program starts because they know it is coming.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="m14-did-it-work.html">M14</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="api-key" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-api-key">
<h3 id="glossary-name-api-key"><a href="#api-key">API key</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A private code that identifies you to an online data service; treat it like a password and keep it out of shared files.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="k08-git-notebooks.html">K8</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="apparent-power" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-apparent-power">
<h3 id="glossary-name-apparent-power"><a href="#apparent-power">Apparent power</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">The combined size of real and reactive power, the square root of MW² plus Mvar², in megavolt-amperes (MVA); a wire&#x27;s heating follows it, not MW alone.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="a17-physical-feasibility.html">A17</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="area-median-income" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-area-median-income">
<h3 id="glossary-name-area-median-income"><a href="#area-median-income">Area median income (AMI)</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">The middle family income of an area, used to sort households into income bands such as 0-30% or 50-80% of it.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="a13-fairness-jobs.html">A13</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="array" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-array">
<h3 id="glossary-name-array"><a href="#array">Array</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">An ordered list or table of numbers; a linear program&#x27;s costs c, rule table A and limits b are arrays.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="b01-algebra-to-lp.html">B1</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="assert" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-assert">
<h3 id="glossary-name-assert"><a href="#assert">Assert</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A line of code that stops a program with a message when a stated condition is false.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="b02-python-data.html">B2</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="attributed-emissions" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-attributed-emissions">
<h3 id="glossary-name-attributed-emissions"><a href="#attributed-emissions">Attributed emissions</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">The share of a grid&#x27;s CO₂ assigned to one user, for example each MWh it uses times that hour&#x27;s average emission factor.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="cf6-shifting-load-to-clean-hours.html">CF6</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="attributional-analysis" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-attributional-analysis">
<h3 id="glossary-name-attributional-analysis"><a href="#attributional-analysis">Attributional analysis</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">An analysis that gives a product its share of today&#x27;s burdens from average data, so the shares of all products add up.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="a11-lca-nexus.html">A11</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="audit-trail" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-audit-trail">
<h3 id="glossary-name-audit-trail"><a href="#audit-trail">Audit trail</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A record that lets someone follow a qualitative analysis from its raw material, such as interview notes, to each finding.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="r05-build-validate.html">R5</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="agc" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-agc">
<h3 id="glossary-name-agc"><a href="#agc">Automatic generation control (AGC)</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">The grid operator&#x27;s computer system that raises or lowers plants over minutes to bring frequency back to 60 Hz.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="03-balancing.html">lesson 3</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="autoregressive-fusion" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-autoregressive-fusion">
<h3 id="glossary-name-autoregressive-fusion"><a href="#autoregressive-fusion">Autoregressive multi-fidelity model</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A linear way to combine two sources: the accurate curve is modeled as a scaled copy of the rough curve plus a learned correction.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="cf8-power-curves-from-scarce-data.html">CF8</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="average-emission-factor" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-average-emission-factor">
<h3 id="glossary-name-average-emission-factor"><a href="#average-emission-factor">Average emission factor</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">An hour&#x27;s CO₂ from all the plants that ran, divided by all the electricity used in that hour.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="cf6-shifting-load-to-clean-hours.html">CF6</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="average-power" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-average-power">
<h3 id="glossary-name-average-power"><a href="#average-power">Average power</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">The energy used over a period divided by the length of that period.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="01-power-energy.html">lesson 1</a></p>
</article>
</section>
<section class="lx-glossary-group" id="glossary-b" aria-labelledby="glossary-heading-b">
<h2 id="glossary-heading-b">B</h2>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="balancing" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-balancing">
<h3 id="glossary-name-balancing"><a href="#balancing">Balancing</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">Keeping the power that plants make equal to the power that people use, at every moment.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="00-grid-operator.html">lesson 0</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="balancing-authority" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-balancing-authority">
<h3 id="glossary-name-balancing-authority"><a href="#balancing-authority">Balancing authority</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">The organization that keeps supply and demand balanced, moment to moment, in its own part of the grid.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="00-grid-operator.html">lesson 0</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="balancing-loop" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-balancing-loop">
<h3 id="glossary-name-balancing-loop"><a href="#balancing-loop">Balancing loop</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A feedback loop with an odd number of negative links, which tends to oppose the change that started it; with long delays it can overshoot or swing back and forth.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="f02-systems-and-map.html">F2</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="baseline" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-baseline">
<h3 id="glossary-name-baseline"><a href="#baseline">Baseline</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">An estimate of what a customer would have used without a demand-response event, against which the cut is measured.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="a07-flexible-demand.html">A7</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="forecast-baseline" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-forecast-baseline">
<h3 id="glossary-name-forecast-baseline"><a href="#forecast-baseline">Baseline forecast</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A simple rule, such as same hour yesterday, that any forecasting model must beat on the same hours to be worth using.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="m10-ml-forecasting.html">M10</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="baseload" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-baseload">
<h3 id="glossary-name-baseload"><a href="#baseload">Baseload operation</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">Operating a plant at a relatively steady output to supply the portion of demand that persists through the day.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="cf4-existing-reactors-hydrogen.html">CF4</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="basis-risk" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-basis-risk">
<h3 id="glossary-name-basis-risk"><a href="#basis-risk">Basis risk</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">The risk that the price where a plant sells differs from the price at which its contract settles, such as its node against a trading hub.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="a02-contracts-risk.html">A2</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="battery-duration" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-battery-duration">
<h3 id="glossary-name-battery-duration"><a href="#battery-duration">Battery duration</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">How many hours a battery can discharge at its rated power: its energy in MWh divided by its power in MW.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="n01-news-lens.html">N1</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="battery-margin" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-battery-margin">
<h3 id="glossary-name-battery-margin"><a href="#battery-margin">Battery margin</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">What a battery earns per megawatt-hour it discharges, after paying for the power it charged and the energy lost on the way.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="a02-contracts-risk.html">A2</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="benchmark" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-benchmark">
<h3 id="glossary-name-benchmark"><a href="#benchmark">Benchmark</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A case whose right answer is known in advance, from a hand calculation or an independent source, used to test a model.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="r05-build-validate.html">R5</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="benefit-per-ton" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-benefit-per-ton">
<h3 id="glossary-name-benefit-per-ton"><a href="#benefit-per-ton">Benefit per ton</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">An estimate of the health harm, in dollars, avoided by not emitting one more ton of a pollutant from a given kind of source, averaged over where those sources are.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="f11-air-climate-people.html">F11</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="forecast-bias" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-forecast-bias">
<h3 id="glossary-name-forecast-bias"><a href="#forecast-bias">Bias</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">The average signed miss of a forecast, showing whether it tends to run too high or too low.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="04-forecasts.html">lesson 4</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="bidding-zone" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-bidding-zone">
<h3 id="glossary-name-bidding-zone"><a href="#bidding-zone">Bidding zone (price zone)</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">An area of a power market in which every seller and buyer gets the same wholesale price for each trading period, as in Europe&#x27;s markets.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="f10-nations-differ.html">F10</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="bcf" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-bcf">
<h3 id="glossary-name-bcf"><a href="#bcf">Billion cubic feet (Bcf)</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A unit of natural-gas volume, a billion cubic feet; EIA often gives gas flows in Bcf a day.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="x02-fossil-transition.html">X2</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="binding-constraint" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-binding-constraint">
<h3 id="glossary-name-binding-constraint"><a href="#binding-constraint">Binding constraint</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A rule that holds exactly at the selected plan, with no room to spare; loosening it may or may not improve the best cost.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="10-write-it-down.html">lesson 10</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="boolean-operators" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-boolean-operators">
<h3 id="glossary-name-boolean-operators"><a href="#boolean-operators">Boolean operators</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">AND, OR and NOT, the words that join search terms: AND narrows a search, OR widens it, NOT leaves terms out.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="r02-literature.html">R2</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="boundary-condition" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-boundary-condition">
<h3 id="glossary-name-boundary-condition"><a href="#boundary-condition">Boundary condition (of a finding)</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">The place, time, data and assumptions a result holds under, stated next to it so readers do not stretch it further.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="r08-communicating.html">R8</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="branch" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-branch">
<h3 id="glossary-name-branch"><a href="#branch">Branch</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A movable label on a line of commits, so a what-if can grow without changing the main line of work.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="k08-git-notebooks.html">K8</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="branch-and-bound" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-branch-and-bound">
<h3 id="glossary-name-branch-and-bound"><a href="#branch-and-bound">Branch and bound</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A search for the best whole-number plan that solves relaxations, splits on a fractional decision (off or on), and drops every branch whose bound cannot beat the best plan found.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="m02-unit-commitment.html">M2</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="break-even-price" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-break-even-price">
<h3 id="glossary-name-break-even-price"><a href="#break-even-price">Break-even price</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">The sale price at which a project&#x27;s net present value is exactly zero; when electricity is its only revenue, with the same costs, output and discounting, it equals the plant&#x27;s levelized cost.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="a01-project-tea.html">A1</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="bridge-power" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-bridge-power">
<h3 id="glossary-name-bridge-power"><a href="#bridge-power">Bridge power</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">Temporary on-site generation that serves part of a load until its grid connection is ready.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="cf7-cost-of-waiting.html">CF7</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="btu" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-btu">
<h3 id="glossary-name-btu"><a href="#btu">Btu (British thermal unit)</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A unit of heat, the energy that warms one pound of water by one degree Fahrenheit; one kilowatt-hour equals 3,412 Btu.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="f05-nuclear-basics.html">F5</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="buffer" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-buffer">
<h3 id="glossary-name-buffer"><a href="#buffer">Buffer (GIS)</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">The zone within a set distance of a map feature, such as everything within 1 km of a wind turbine.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="r04-data.html">R4</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="building-code" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-building-code">
<h3 id="glossary-name-building-code"><a href="#building-code">Building code</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">The rules a city, county or state sets for how new buildings must be built, such as insulation, wiring and safety.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="f01-five-scales.html">F1</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="building-envelope" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-building-envelope">
<h3 id="glossary-name-building-envelope"><a href="#building-envelope">Building envelope</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A building&#x27;s outer shell, its walls, roof, windows and floor, whose insulation and air sealing set how fast heat leaks out.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="a15-efficiency-electrification.html">A15</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="bulk-power-system" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-bulk-power-system">
<h3 id="glossary-name-bulk-power-system"><a href="#bulk-power-system">Bulk power system</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">The large power plants and the high-voltage transmission network that carry electricity over long distances, as distinct from the local distribution grid.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="x01-under-the-hood.html">X1</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="bus" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-bus">
<h3 id="glossary-name-bus"><a href="#bus">Bus</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A point of the network where plants, loads and lines meet, such as a substation; a network model has one balance rule per bus.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="m01-dispatch-to-lmp.html">M1</a></p>
</article>
</section>
<section class="lx-glossary-group" id="glossary-c" aria-labelledby="glossary-heading-c">
<h2 id="glossary-heading-c">C</h2>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="caidi" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-caidi">
<h3 id="glossary-name-caidi"><a href="#caidi">CAIDI</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">Customer Average Interruption Duration Index: the average minutes to restore one interruption, SAIDI divided by SAIFI.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="f06-grid-and-outages.html">F6</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="calibration" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-calibration">
<h3 id="glossary-name-calibration"><a href="#calibration">Calibration (of a band)</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A band is calibrated when it holds what it claims: a 90% band holds about 90% of new outcomes, overall and within groups that matter.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="m09-surrogates-uq.html">M9</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="capacity" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-capacity">
<h3 id="glossary-name-capacity"><a href="#capacity">Capacity</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">The most power a plant can produce at once, often called its nameplate size.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="05-capacity-factor.html">lesson 5</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="capacity-accreditation" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-capacity-accreditation">
<h3 id="glossary-name-capacity-accreditation"><a href="#capacity-accreditation">Capacity accreditation</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">The share of a resource&#x27;s MW that a grid counts toward its adequacy target, judged by how much the resource lowers the risk of a shortfall.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="a05-adequacy.html">A5</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="capacity-bound" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-capacity-bound">
<h3 id="glossary-name-capacity-bound"><a href="#capacity-bound">Capacity bound</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">The largest size a model is allowed to choose for a piece of equipment.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="cf4-existing-reactors-hydrogen.html">CF4</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="capacity-credit" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-capacity-credit">
<h3 id="glossary-name-capacity-credit"><a href="#capacity-credit">Capacity credit</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">The share of a plant&#x27;s size that planners count on to meet the year&#x27;s peak, judged by how much it lowers the risk of a shortage.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="ck-m-unseen-problem.html">CK-M</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="capacity-expansion" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-capacity-expansion">
<h3 id="glossary-name-capacity-expansion"><a href="#capacity-expansion">Capacity expansion model</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">An optimization model that decides what to build, as well as how to run it, at least cost.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="13-capstone.html">lesson 13</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="capacity-factor" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-capacity-factor">
<h3 id="glossary-name-capacity-factor"><a href="#capacity-factor">Capacity factor</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">The energy a plant actually made over a period, divided by the energy it would have made running at full capacity the whole time.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="05-capacity-factor.html">lesson 5</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="capacity-market" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-capacity-market">
<h3 id="glossary-name-capacity-market"><a href="#capacity-market">Capacity market</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">An auction, run ahead of time, that pays plants and other resources for being available, in an amount a planner sets, on top of energy prices.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="a03-market-design.html">A3</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="capacity-payment" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-capacity-payment">
<h3 id="glossary-name-capacity-payment"><a href="#capacity-payment">Capacity payment</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">Money a plant earns for being available to run when needed, as in a capacity market, apart from the energy it sells.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="cf4-existing-reactors-hydrogen.html">CF4</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="capacity-utilization" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-capacity-utilization">
<h3 id="glossary-name-capacity-utilization"><a href="#capacity-utilization">Capacity utilization</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">The energy a machine used or made over a year divided by its size times 8,760 hours, its average loading, so half power all year gives 50%, as full power for half the year does.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="m11-tea-in-models.html">M11</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="capital-cost" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-capital-cost">
<h3 id="glossary-name-capital-cost"><a href="#capital-cost">Capital cost</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">The money spent to build a power plant, usually given per kilowatt of capacity, before it makes any electricity.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="07-cost.html">lesson 7</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="capital-recovery-factor" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-capital-recovery-factor">
<h3 id="glossary-name-capital-recovery-factor"><a href="#capital-recovery-factor">Capital recovery factor (CRF)</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">The share of a building cost that must be repaid each year, with interest, to pay it off over a given number of years.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="07-cost.html">lesson 7</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="capital-stack" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-capital-stack">
<h3 id="glossary-name-capital-stack"><a href="#capital-stack">Capital stack</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">The layers of money that pay for a project, such as senior debt, tax equity and the sponsor&#x27;s equity, each with its own place in the order of payment.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="x05-project-finance.html">X5</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="capture-price" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-capture-price">
<h3 id="glossary-name-capture-price"><a href="#capture-price">Capture price</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">The average market price a plant&#x27;s output earns, each hour weighted by what the plant produced in it.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="a03-market-design.html">A3</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="capture-ratio" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-capture-ratio">
<h3 id="glossary-name-capture-ratio"><a href="#capture-ratio">Capture ratio</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A market price averaged over the hours a plant produces, weighted by its output, divided by that price&#x27;s average over all hours.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="a02-contracts-risk.html">A2</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="carbon-budget" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-carbon-budget">
<h3 id="glossary-name-carbon-budget"><a href="#carbon-budget">Carbon budget</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A cap on the total CO₂ emitted over many years, a limit on a stock rather than on one year&#x27;s flow.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="f02-systems-and-map.html">F2</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="carbon-capture" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-carbon-capture">
<h3 id="glossary-name-carbon-capture"><a href="#carbon-capture">Carbon capture and storage (CCS)</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">Capturing CO₂ from a source such as a chimney before it reaches the air, and storing it, usually deep underground.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="x02-fossil-transition.html">X2</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="carbon-removal" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-carbon-removal">
<h3 id="glossary-name-carbon-removal"><a href="#carbon-removal">Carbon dioxide removal (CDR)</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">Taking CO₂ that is already in the air and storing it in trees, soils, rock, minerals or products.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="x02-fossil-transition.html">X2</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="carbon-intensity" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-carbon-intensity">
<h3 id="glossary-name-carbon-intensity"><a href="#carbon-intensity">Carbon intensity</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">The CO2 emitted for each unit of electricity, for example in tonnes per megawatt-hour.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="12-trade-offs.html">lesson 12</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="carbon-price" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-carbon-price">
<h3 id="glossary-name-carbon-price"><a href="#carbon-price">Carbon price</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A charge per tonne of CO2 emitted, added to costs so that cleaner choices become relatively cheaper.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="12-trade-offs.html">lesson 12</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="carnot-limit" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-carnot-limit">
<h3 id="glossary-name-carnot-limit"><a href="#carnot-limit">Carnot limit</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">The largest share of heat any heat engine can turn into work: 1 minus the cold temperature over the hot temperature, both in kelvin.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="f04-power-plants.html">F4</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="carrying-cost" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-carrying-cost">
<h3 id="glossary-name-carrying-cost"><a href="#carrying-cost">Carrying cost</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">What money tied up in buildings or equipment costs while they earn nothing: the interest, or the return it could have earned elsewhere.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="cf7-cost-of-waiting.html">CF7</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="cash-flow-available-for-debt-service" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-cash-flow-available-for-debt-service">
<h3 id="glossary-name-cash-flow-available-for-debt-service"><a href="#cash-flow-available-for-debt-service">Cash flow available for debt service (CFADS)</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A project&#x27;s revenue minus its operating costs in a period: the cash that can pay the loan.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="x05-project-finance.html">X5</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="causal-loop-diagram" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-causal-loop-diagram">
<h3 id="glossary-name-causal-loop-diagram"><a href="#causal-loop-diagram">Causal-loop diagram</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A map of causes and effects in which every arrow carries a sign: plus if more of the cause brings more of the effect, minus if it brings less.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="f02-systems-and-map.html">F2</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="chain-reaction" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-chain-reaction">
<h3 id="glossary-name-chain-reaction"><a href="#chain-reaction">Chain reaction</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A run of fissions in which the neutrons from each split go on to split more atoms; a reactor holds it steady, with each generation as large as the last.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="f05-nuclear-basics.html">F5</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="chance-constraint" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-chance-constraint">
<h3 id="glossary-name-chance-constraint"><a href="#chance-constraint">Chance constraint</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A rule required to hold with a chosen probability, for example at least a 95% chance of meeting a week&#x27;s demand, rather than with certainty.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="cf1-supply-chain-microgrids.html">CF1</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="checksum" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-checksum">
<h3 id="glossary-name-checksum"><a href="#checksum">Checksum</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A short fingerprint computed from a file&#x27;s bytes, such as SHA-256, that changes if even one byte of the file changes.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="k08-git-notebooks.html">K8</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="choice-experiment" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-choice-experiment">
<h3 id="glossary-name-choice-experiment"><a href="#choice-experiment">Choice experiment</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A survey method in which people choose repeatedly between offers whose features vary, so that the weight of each feature can be estimated.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="x06-social-methods.html">X6</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="circuit-breaker" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-circuit-breaker">
<h3 id="glossary-name-circuit-breaker"><a href="#circuit-breaker">Circuit breaker</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A switch that opens by itself when it senses a fault, cutting the power to everything beyond it, and can be closed again.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="f06-grid-and-outages.html">F6</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="clean-clone" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-clean-clone">
<h3 id="glossary-name-clean-clone"><a href="#clean-clone">Clean clone</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A fresh clone of a repository into a new, empty folder, run with only what the repository holds, so that no file left on your own machine can change the result.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="k08-git-notebooks.html">K8</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="clean-energy-standard" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-clean-energy-standard">
<h3 id="glossary-name-clean-energy-standard"><a href="#clean-energy-standard">Clean-energy standard</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A rule that a set share of the electricity sold in a year comes from sources the rule counts as clean; sellers prove it with certificates, each a record of one MWh from a counted source.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="a12-policy-instruments.html">A12</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="clearing-price" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-clearing-price">
<h3 id="glossary-name-clearing-price"><a href="#clearing-price">Clearing price</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">The price at which supply meets demand in a market; in a uniform-price market, every seller that runs in that hour is paid it.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="08-merit-order.html">lesson 8</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="clone" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-clone">
<h3 id="glossary-name-clone"><a href="#clone">Clone</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A complete new copy of a repository, with its files and its whole history.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="k08-git-notebooks.html">K8</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="cluster-study" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-cluster-study">
<h3 id="glossary-name-cluster-study"><a href="#cluster-study">Cluster study</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A study of every interconnection request in one window together, which finds the network upgrades the group needs and splits their cost.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="a06-interconnection.html">A6</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="clustering" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-clustering">
<h3 id="glossary-name-clustering"><a href="#clustering">Clustering</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">Grouping similar items, such as days with similar demand and weather, so that one representative can stand for each group.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="r02-literature.html">R2</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="co-op" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-co-op">
<h3 id="glossary-name-co-op"><a href="#co-op">Co-op (electric cooperative)</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">An electric utility owned by the members it serves, common in rural areas.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="r01-framing.html">R1</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="co-optimize" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-co-optimize">
<h3 id="glossary-name-co-optimize"><a href="#co-optimize">Co-optimize</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">To choose several decisions together in one model, so each is set with the others in view rather than one after another.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="cf5-drawing-the-boundary.html">CF5</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="coefficient-of-performance" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-coefficient-of-performance">
<h3 id="glossary-name-coefficient-of-performance"><a href="#coefficient-of-performance">Coefficient of performance (COP)</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">Heat a heat pump delivers divided by the electricity it uses; a COP of 3 means 3 kWh of heat for each kWh of electricity.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="f03-energy-services.html">F3</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="cogeneration" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-cogeneration">
<h3 id="glossary-name-cogeneration"><a href="#cogeneration">Cogeneration</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">Making two useful products from one fuel or heat source, such as electricity and heat, steam or cooling, instead of making each separately.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="cf5-drawing-the-boundary.html">CF5</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="coincident-peak" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-coincident-peak">
<h3 id="glossary-name-coincident-peak"><a href="#coincident-peak">Coincident peak</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">The most a group of customers draws in the same hour; it is lower than the sum of their own peaks when they peak at different times.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="a15-efficiency-electrification.html">A15</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="combined-cycle" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-combined-cycle">
<h3 id="glossary-name-combined-cycle"><a href="#combined-cycle">Combined-cycle plant</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A gas power plant that burns gas in a turbine and uses the hot exhaust to make steam for a second turbine, so it gets more electricity from the same fuel.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="00-grid-operator.html">lesson 0</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="commit" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-commit">
<h3 id="glossary-name-commit"><a href="#commit">Commit</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A recorded snapshot of a project&#x27;s tracked files as they were staged, with a message, its author and time, and a link to the commit before it.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="k08-git-notebooks.html">K8</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="compound-hazard" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-compound-hazard">
<h3 id="glossary-name-compound-hazard"><a href="#compound-hazard">Compound hazard</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">Two or more hazards striking at the same time, such as heat and drought, whose combined harm can exceed the sum of each alone.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="a09-hazards.html">A9</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="concentrated-solar" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-concentrated-solar">
<h3 id="glossary-name-concentrated-solar"><a href="#concentrated-solar">Concentrated solar power</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">Mirrors focus sunlight to heat a fluid; the heat runs a turbine or a process, and it can be stored for hours in tanks.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="cf2-cost-per-kg-vs-system-cost.html">CF2</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="concept-matrix" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-concept-matrix">
<h3 id="glossary-name-concept-matrix"><a href="#concept-matrix">Concept matrix</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A table with papers in rows and ideas in columns, coded by a stated rule, that shows what a literature covers and what it leaves out.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="r02-literature.html">R2</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="condenser" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-condenser">
<h3 id="glossary-name-condenser"><a href="#condenser">Condenser</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">The part of a steam plant that cools the used steam back into water, so it can be pumped back to the boiler; most of the plant&#x27;s waste heat leaves here.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="f04-power-plants.html">F4</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="condensing-furnace" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-condensing-furnace">
<h3 id="glossary-name-condensing-furnace"><a href="#condensing-furnace">Condensing furnace</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A furnace that recovers additional heat by condensing water vapor in its exhaust, with efficiency depending on its design and operating conditions.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="a18-city-plan.html">A18</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="conditional-price" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-conditional-price">
<h3 id="glossary-name-conditional-price"><a href="#conditional-price">Conditional price</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A price read from a linear program in which the on/off decisions are held fixed; it holds only for that commitment.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="m02-unit-commitment.html">M2</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="conflict-of-interest" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-conflict-of-interest">
<h3 id="glossary-name-conflict-of-interest"><a href="#conflict-of-interest">Conflict of interest</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A financial or other tie that could bias, or seem to bias, a researcher&#x27;s work, and so must be declared.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="r09-integrity-stakeholders.html">R9</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="confounding" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-confounding">
<h3 id="glossary-name-confounding"><a href="#confounding">Confounding</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">When something other than the program, such as a second change at the same time, also differs between the groups and moves the outcome.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="m14-did-it-work.html">M14</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="congestion" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-congestion">
<h3 id="glossary-name-congestion"><a href="#congestion">Congestion</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A power line carrying all it is allowed to, so cheaper power cannot reach where it is needed and prices can differ by location.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="08-merit-order.html">lesson 8</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="congestion-rent" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-congestion-rent">
<h3 id="glossary-name-congestion-rent"><a href="#congestion-rent">Congestion rent</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">What loads pay at their locational prices minus what generators are paid at theirs; in a DC model it equals the sum, over the full lines, of each line&#x27;s shadow price times its flow.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="m01-dispatch-to-lmp.html">M1</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="consequential-analysis" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-consequential-analysis">
<h3 id="glossary-name-consequential-analysis"><a href="#consequential-analysis">Consequential analysis</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">An analysis of what changes because of a decision, in the short run through how plants run and in the long run through what gets built.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="a10-emissions-questions.html">A10</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="consequential-emissions" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-consequential-emissions">
<h3 id="glossary-name-consequential-emissions"><a href="#consequential-emissions">Consequential emissions</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">The change in what power plants actually emit because of a decision, as the grid re-dispatches; it is counted with marginal, not average, emission factors.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="a07-flexible-demand.html">A7</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="constraint" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-constraint">
<h3 id="glossary-name-constraint"><a href="#constraint">Constraint</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A rule every solution must obey, such as supply equals demand or no plant above its size.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="10-write-it-down.html">lesson 10</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="control-rod" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-control-rod">
<h3 id="glossary-name-control-rod"><a href="#control-rod">Control rod</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A rod of neutron-absorbing material that is pushed into a reactor core to slow the chain reaction, or pulled out to speed it up.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="f05-nuclear-basics.html">F5</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="control-variable" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-control-variable">
<h3 id="glossary-name-control-variable"><a href="#control-variable">Control variable</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A measured trait, such as home size, put into a regression so that groups are compared at equal values of it; it cannot fix a difference nobody measured.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="m14-did-it-work.html">M14</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="coolant" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-coolant">
<h3 id="glossary-name-coolant"><a href="#coolant">Coolant</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">The fluid, such as water, helium, liquid sodium or molten salt, that carries heat away from a reactor core.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="f05-nuclear-basics.html">F5</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="coordinate-reference-system" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-coordinate-reference-system">
<h3 id="glossary-name-coordinate-reference-system"><a href="#coordinate-reference-system">Coordinate reference system (CRS)</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">The rule that ties map coordinates to places on Earth; some keep areas true, others keep distances, none keeps both everywhere.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="r04-data.html">R4</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="utc" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-utc">
<h3 id="glossary-name-utc"><a href="#utc">Coordinated Universal Time (UTC)</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">The world reference clock, with no daylight saving; EIA stamps its hourly grid data in it.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="b02-python-data.html">B2</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="coordination-cost" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-coordination-cost">
<h3 id="glossary-name-coordination-cost"><a href="#coordination-cost">Coordination cost</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">What it costs to enroll, meter, control and pay each device or customer in a program, whatever the device&#x27;s size.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="a07-flexible-demand.html">A7</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="correlated-failure" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-correlated-failure">
<h3 id="glossary-name-correlated-failure"><a href="#correlated-failure">Correlated failure</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">Many parts of a system failing together because they share one cause, such as extreme cold freezing plants and gas supply at once.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="a09-hazards.html">A9</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="cost-of-capital" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-cost-of-capital">
<h3 id="glossary-name-cost-of-capital"><a href="#cost-of-capital">Cost of capital</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">The yearly return an owner&#x27;s lenders and investors require on money tied up in equipment; the real cost of capital leaves inflation out.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="m05-microgrid-size-and-run.html">M5</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="cost-of-saved-energy" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-cost-of-saved-energy">
<h3 id="glossary-name-cost-of-saved-energy"><a href="#cost-of-saved-energy">Cost of saved energy</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">What a measure costs per unit of energy it saves: its extra cost spread over its life at a discount rate, plus any extra yearly cost, divided by the energy it saves each year.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="a15-efficiency-electrification.html">A15</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="cost-of-service" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-cost-of-service">
<h3 id="glossary-name-cost-of-service"><a href="#cost-of-service">Cost of service</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">What it costs a utility to serve a customer or a class of customers: energy, plants, wires, meters and billing.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="a04-retail-tariffs.html">A4</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="abatement-cost" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-abatement-cost">
<h3 id="glossary-name-abatement-cost"><a href="#abatement-cost">Cost per tonne avoided</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A measure&#x27;s net yearly cost, its capital spread over its life plus upkeep minus the energy it saves, divided by the tonnes of CO2 it avoids a year.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="a18-city-plan.html">A18</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="cost-surface" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-cost-surface">
<h3 id="glossary-name-cost-surface"><a href="#cost-surface">Cost surface</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A map that gives the cost of building a line or a road through each cell, for example in dollars per km.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="a19-gis-siting.html">A19</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="counterfactual" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-counterfactual">
<h3 id="glossary-name-counterfactual"><a href="#counterfactual">Counterfactual</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">What would have happened without the change being judged; every saving or effect is measured against one.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="n01-news-lens.html">N1</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="coverage" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-coverage">
<h3 id="glossary-name-coverage"><a href="#coverage">Coverage</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">The share of actual outcomes that land inside a forecast&#x27;s band; on its own it rewards wide bands.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="m10-ml-forecasting.html">M10</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="co2e" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-co2e">
<h3 id="glossary-name-co2e"><a href="#co2e">CO₂e (carbon dioxide equivalent)</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">Greenhouse gases such as methane counted as the mass of CO₂ that would warm the climate as much over a set period, so they can be added up.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="a16-hydrogen-ptx.html">A16</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="credit-roles" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-credit-roles">
<h3 id="glossary-name-credit-roles"><a href="#credit-roles">CRediT contributor roles</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A standard list of 14 names for what each author did, such as conceptualization (shaping the question), data curation (cleaning and documenting data) and formal analysis.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="r09-integrity-stakeholders.html">R9</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="criticality" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-criticality">
<h3 id="glossary-name-criticality"><a href="#criticality">Critical (of a reactor)</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">The steady state of a chain reaction, with a multiplication factor of exactly 1; it is a reactor&#x27;s normal operating state, not an emergency.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="f05-nuclear-basics.html">F5</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="critical-load" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-critical-load">
<h3 id="glossary-name-critical-load"><a href="#critical-load">Critical load</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">The loads that must stay on in an outage, such as a hospital or a water plant; the rest can be switched off.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="f07-microgrids.html">F7</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="cross-subsidy" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-cross-subsidy">
<h3 id="glossary-name-cross-subsidy"><a href="#cross-subsidy">Cross-subsidy</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">When some customers pay more than the cost of serving them so that others can pay less.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="a04-retail-tariffs.html">A4</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="crps" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-crps">
<h3 id="glossary-name-crps"><a href="#crps">CRPS</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">The continuous ranked probability score of a whole forecast distribution: twice its pinball loss averaged over every quantile level; lower is better.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="m09-surrogates-uq.html">M9</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="crystallization" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-crystallization">
<h3 id="glossary-name-crystallization"><a href="#crystallization">Crystallization (in an absorption chiller)</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">The salt solution in an absorption chiller turning to solid crystals when it gets too concentrated or too cold, which blocks the machine; the chiller must stay clear of that limit.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="cf5-drawing-the-boundary.html">CF5</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="cube-law" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-cube-law">
<h3 id="glossary-name-cube-law"><a href="#cube-law">Cube law</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">The power carried by the wind grows with the cube of its speed (twice the speed, eight times the power); a real turbine&#x27;s output follows it only roughly, and only between its cut-in and rated speeds.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="05-capacity-factor.html">lesson 5</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="curtailment" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-curtailment">
<h3 id="glossary-name-curtailment"><a href="#curtailment">Curtailment (spilling)</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">Turning a wind or solar farm below what the weather allows, usually because the grid has more power than it can use at that moment.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="00-grid-operator.html">lesson 0</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="customer-class" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-customer-class">
<h3 id="glossary-name-customer-class"><a href="#customer-class">Customer class</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A group of customers, such as homes or businesses, that a utility bills under the same tariffs.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="a04-retail-tariffs.html">A4</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="customer-hours" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-customer-hours">
<h3 id="glossary-name-customer-hours"><a href="#customer-hours">Customer-hours</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">Customers without power times the hours they are out: 100 customers out for 3 hours is 300 customer-hours.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="r10-question-studio.html">R10</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="customer-minutes" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-customer-minutes">
<h3 id="glossary-name-customer-minutes"><a href="#customer-minutes">Customer-minutes</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">The number of customers without power times the minutes they wait: 10 homes dark for an hour is 600 customer-minutes.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="f06-grid-and-outages.html">F6</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="cut-in-speed" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-cut-in-speed">
<h3 id="glossary-name-cut-in-speed"><a href="#cut-in-speed">Cut-in speed</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">The lowest wind speed at which a turbine starts to make electricity.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="05-capacity-factor.html">lesson 5</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="cut-out-speed" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-cut-out-speed">
<h3 id="glossary-name-cut-out-speed"><a href="#cut-out-speed">Cut-out speed</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">The wind speed above which a turbine shuts down to protect itself.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="05-capacity-factor.html">lesson 5</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="heat-pump-cut-out" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-heat-pump-cut-out">
<h3 id="glossary-name-heat-pump-cut-out"><a href="#heat-pump-cut-out">Cut-out temperature (heat pump)</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">The outdoor temperature below which a heat pump&#x27;s compressor, the pump that moves its heat, switches off, so a backup heater must take over.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="f03-energy-services.html">F3</a></p>
</article>
</section>
<section class="lx-glossary-group" id="glossary-d" aria-labelledby="glossary-heading-d">
<h2 id="glossary-heading-d">D</h2>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="data-center" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-data-center">
<h3 id="glossary-name-data-center"><a href="#data-center">Data center</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A building full of computers that store and process data; on the grid it is one large customer that draws power around the clock.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="f08-large-loads.html">F8</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="data-leakage" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-data-leakage">
<h3 id="glossary-name-data-leakage"><a href="#data-leakage">Data leakage</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">Letting a model use information it would not have when the forecast is made, such as a later hour&#x27;s actual value; it makes scores look better than they can be.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="m10-ml-forecasting.html">M10</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="data-licence" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-data-licence">
<h3 id="glossary-name-data-licence"><a href="#data-licence">Data license</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">The terms under which a dataset may be used and shared, such as public domain, CC BY or a signed data agreement.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="r04-data.html">R4</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="data-note" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-data-note">
<h3 id="glossary-name-data-note"><a href="#data-note">Data note</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A short record of where a dataset came from, its license, units and time base, and every cleaning step with its rule, count and effect.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="r04-data.html">R4</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="dataframe" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-dataframe">
<h3 id="glossary-name-dataframe"><a href="#dataframe">DataFrame</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A pandas table with named columns and an index, such as one row per hour.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="b02-python-data.html">B2</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="day-ahead-forecast" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-day-ahead-forecast">
<h3 id="glossary-name-day-ahead-forecast"><a href="#day-ahead-forecast">Day-ahead forecast</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A grid operator&#x27;s estimate, made the day before, of how much power customers will use in each hour.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="04-forecasts.html">lesson 4</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="daylight-saving-time" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-daylight-saving-time">
<h3 id="glossary-name-daylight-saving-time"><a href="#daylight-saving-time">Daylight saving time</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">Clocks moved an hour ahead in summer, giving one 23-hour day in spring and one 25-hour day in autumn.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="b02-python-data.html">B2</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="dc-power-flow" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-dc-power-flow">
<h3 id="glossary-name-dc-power-flow"><a href="#dc-power-flow">DC power flow</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A linear approximation of real-power flows that sets each line&#x27;s flow from the voltage-angle difference across it, holds voltage magnitudes fixed, assumes small angles, and leaves out losses and reactive power.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="m01-dispatch-to-lmp.html">M1</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="debt-service-coverage-ratio" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-debt-service-coverage-ratio">
<h3 id="glossary-name-debt-service-coverage-ratio"><a href="#debt-service-coverage-ratio">Debt-service coverage ratio (DSCR)</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">The cash available for debt service divided by the loan payment due; a lender asks for a minimum, such as 1.30, as a cushion.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="x05-project-finance.html">X5</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="decay-heat" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-decay-heat">
<h3 id="glossary-name-decay-heat"><a href="#decay-heat">Decay heat</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">Heat that the radioactive fission products in used fuel keep giving off after the chain reaction has stopped.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="f05-nuclear-basics.html">F5</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="decision-analysis" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-decision-analysis">
<h3 id="glossary-name-decision-analysis"><a href="#decision-analysis">Decision analysis</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A structured way to choose among options under uncertainty, weighing each possible outcome by how likely and how valuable it is.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="r10-question-studio.html">R10</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="decision-variable" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-decision-variable">
<h3 id="glossary-name-decision-variable"><a href="#decision-variable">Decision variable</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A quantity the model is free to choose, such as how much each plant makes each hour.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="10-write-it-down.html">lesson 10</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="deep-uncertainty" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-deep-uncertainty">
<h3 id="glossary-name-deep-uncertainty"><a href="#deep-uncertainty">Deep uncertainty</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A situation where the people involved do not know, or cannot agree on, the possible outcomes, their odds or the right model.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="r06-uncertainty-properly.html">R6</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="delay-cost-per-mw-month" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-delay-cost-per-mw-month">
<h3 id="glossary-name-delay-cost-per-mw-month"><a href="#delay-cost-per-mw-month">Delay cost per MW-month</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A delay&#x27;s cost in present value divided by the load&#x27;s size in MW and by the months it waits, so waits of different lengths and loads of different sizes can be compared.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="cf7-cost-of-waiting.html">CF7</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="deliverability" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-deliverability">
<h3 id="glossary-name-deliverability"><a href="#deliverability">Deliverability</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">Whether power from a plant can actually reach the buyer over the grid, usually judged by both being in the same region.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="a16-hydrogen-ptx.html">A16</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="demand" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-demand">
<h3 id="glossary-name-demand"><a href="#demand">Demand (load)</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">The total power that all users on a grid draw at a given moment.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="00-grid-operator.html">lesson 0</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="demand-charge" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-demand-charge">
<h3 id="glossary-name-demand-charge"><a href="#demand-charge">Demand charge</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A part of a power bill charged per kW of the customer&#x27;s busiest hour (or interval) in the month, not per kWh.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="a04-retail-tariffs.html">A4</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="demand-response" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-demand-response">
<h3 id="glossary-name-demand-response"><a href="#demand-response">Demand response</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">Electricity users cutting or shifting their use when the grid asks, usually in return for a payment.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="06-three-jobs.html">lesson 6</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="derate" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-derate">
<h3 id="glossary-name-derate"><a href="#derate">Derate</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A cut in the most a power plant can produce while it keeps running, for example when its cooling water is too warm or its equipment freezes.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="a09-hazards.html">A9</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="desalination" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-desalination">
<h3 id="glossary-name-desalination"><a href="#desalination">Desalination</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">Removing salt from seawater or salty groundwater to make fresh water, with heat or with electricity.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="f05-nuclear-basics.html">F5</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="design-day" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-design-day">
<h3 id="glossary-name-design-day"><a href="#design-day">Design day</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A cold (or hot) day chosen for planning, so that equipment and networks are sized for its highest hour rather than for an average day.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="a15-efficiency-electrification.html">A15</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="deterministic-equivalent" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-deterministic-equivalent">
<h3 id="glossary-name-deterministic-equivalent"><a href="#deterministic-equivalent">Deterministic equivalent</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A chance constraint rewritten as an ordinary rule with a safety margin, for example planning for the demand level that is exceeded with only the allowed probability.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="cf1-supply-chain-microgrids.html">CF1</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="developer" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-developer">
<h3 id="glossary-name-developer"><a href="#developer">Developer</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">The company that plans, builds and owns a new facility, such as a factory or a data center.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="cf7-cost-of-waiting.html">CF7</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="diff" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-diff">
<h3 id="glossary-name-diff"><a href="#diff">Diff</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A line-by-line list of what changed between two versions of a file, with removed lines marked minus and added lines plus.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="k08-git-notebooks.html">K8</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="difference-in-differences" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-difference-in-differences">
<h3 id="glossary-name-difference-in-differences"><a href="#difference-in-differences">Difference-in-differences</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A comparison of how much an outcome changed in a group that got a program against how much it changed in a similar group that did not.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="r03-system-and-method.html">R3</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="diffusion-curve" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-diffusion-curve">
<h3 id="glossary-name-diffusion-curve"><a href="#diffusion-curve">Diffusion curve</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">How the share of homes, firms or output using a new technology grows over time, often slowly at first, then faster, then leveling off.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="x03-transitions-history.html">X3</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="discount-rate" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-discount-rate">
<h3 id="glossary-name-discount-rate"><a href="#discount-rate">Discount rate</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">The yearly rate used to turn money paid or received in the future into its value today.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="07-cost.html">lesson 7</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="discounted-cash-flow" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-discounted-cash-flow">
<h3 id="glossary-name-discounted-cash-flow"><a href="#discounted-cash-flow">Discounted cash flow</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">Valuing a project&#x27;s future yearly cash flows in today&#x27;s money, each discounted at a chosen rate; their sum is the project&#x27;s net present value.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="cf4-existing-reactors-hydrogen.html">CF4</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="dispatch" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-dispatch">
<h3 id="glossary-name-dispatch"><a href="#dispatch">Dispatch</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">Deciding how much power each plant should make, hour by hour or minute by minute.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="00-grid-operator.html">lesson 0</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="dispatchable" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-dispatchable">
<h3 id="glossary-name-dispatchable"><a href="#dispatchable">Dispatchable plant</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">A power plant whose output the operator can turn up or down on request, such as a gas plant.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="00-grid-operator.html">lesson 0</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="distribution" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-distribution">
<h3 id="glossary-name-distribution"><a href="#distribution">Distribution</a></h3>
<p class="lx-glossary-definition">The lower-voltage part of the grid, from substations along feeders and laterals to homes and businesses.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="f06-grid-and-outages.html">F6</a></p>
</article>
<article class="lx-glossary-entry" id="distribution-factor" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="glossary-name-distribution-factor">
<h3 id="glossary-name-distribution-factor"><a href="#distribution-factor">Distribution factor</a></h3>
