<p class="lx-glossary-definition">Protecting power plants and fuel supply against freezing, with insulation, electric heaters on exposed pipes (heat tracing), enclosures and cold-weather procedures.</p>
<p class="lx-glossary-lesson">Learn in <a href="a09-hazards.html">A9</a></p>
</article>
</section>

<p>No terms in this group.</p>
</section>

</section>

{"@type": "DefinedTerm", "@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#capital-cost", "name": "Capital cost", "description": "The money spent to build a power plant, usually given per "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#definedtermset"}}, {"@type": "DefinedTerm", "@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#capital-recovery-factor", "name": "Capital {"@type": "DefinedTerm", "@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#carbon-price", "name": "Carbon price", "description": "A charge per tonne of CO2 emitted, added to costs so that "url": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#congestion-rent", "inDefinedTermSet": {"@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#definedtermset"}}, {"@type": "DefinedTerm", "url": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#consequential-emissions", "inDefinedTermSet": {"@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#definedtermset"}}, {"@type": "DefinedTerm", "@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#unserved-energy", "name": "Unserved energy", "description": "Demand that could not be met, so some customers lost power.", "url": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#unserved-energy", "inDefinedTermSet": {"@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#definedtermset"}}, {"@type": "DefinedTerm", "@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#uplift", "name": "Uplift payment", "description": "A payment outside the market price that covers costs a scheduled plant cannot recover at "inDefinedTermSet": {"@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#definedtermset"}}, {"@type": "DefinedTerm", "@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#uranium-235", "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#uranium-235", "inDefinedTermSet": {"@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#definedtermset"}}, {"@type": "DefinedTerm", "@id": {"@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#definedtermset"}}, {"@type": "DefinedTerm", "@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#utm", "name": "UTM (Universal "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#utm", "inDefinedTermSet": {"@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#definedtermset"}}, {"@type": "DefinedTerm", "@id": "DefinedTerm", "@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#value-of-coupling", "name": "Value of coupling", "description": "How much cheaper a system is with devices that link its {"@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#definedtermset"}}, {"@type": "DefinedTerm", "@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#value-of-information", "name": "Value "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#value-of-information", "inDefinedTermSet": {"@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#definedtermset"}}, {"@type": "DefinedTerm", "@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#value-of-lost-load", "name": "Value of lost load", "description": "What a customer loses when power is cut, per hour or per kWh not "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#definedtermset"}}, {"@type": "DefinedTerm", "@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#value-of-stochastic-solution", "name": "Value of the stochastic solution (VSS)", "description": "How much the stochastic program's plan saves, in expectation, against the plan built for the average future.", "url": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#value-of-stochastic-solution", "inDefinedTermSet": {"@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#definedtermset"}}, {"@type": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#definedtermset"}}, {"@type": "DefinedTerm", "@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#variable-renewables", "name": "Variable renewables", "description": "Wind and solar power, whose output follows the weather: they can be turned down but not up.", "url": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#variable-renewables", "inDefinedTermSet": {"@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#definedtermset"}}, {"@type": "DefinedTerm", "@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#variogram", "name": "Variogram", "description": "A measure of how much values at two places differ, on average, as a function of the distance "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#definedtermset"}}, {"@type": "DefinedTerm", "@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#vector", "name": "Vector", "description": "An {"@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#definedtermset"}}, {"@type": "DefinedTerm", "@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#verification", "name": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#verification", "inDefinedTermSet": {"@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#definedtermset"}}, {"@type": "DefinedTerm", "@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#definedtermset"}}, {"@type": "DefinedTerm", "@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#version-pin", "name": "Version pin", "inDefinedTermSet": {"@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#definedtermset"}}, {"@type": "DefinedTerm", "@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#definedtermset"}}, {"@type": "DefinedTerm", "@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#virtual-power-plant", "name": "Virtual power "@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#voltage", "name": "Voltage", "description": "The electrical push that drives current through a wire, measured in volts (V); 1 kilovolt (kV) is 1,000 V.", "url": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#voltage", "inDefinedTermSet": {"@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#definedtermset"}}, {"@type": "DefinedTerm", "@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#voltage-angle", "name": "Voltage angle", "description": "How far the alternating voltage at one bus runs ahead of the voltage "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#voltage-angle", "inDefinedTermSet": {"@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#definedtermset"}}, {"@type": "DefinedTerm", "@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#definedtermset"}}, {"@type": "DefinedTerm", "@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#waste-heat", "name": "Waste heat", "inDefinedTermSet": {"@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#definedtermset"}}, {"@type": "DefinedTerm", "@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#water-consumption", "name": "Water consumption", "description": "Water taken and not returned, mostly lost to evaporation, so it is no longer "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#water-withdrawal", "inDefinedTermSet": {"@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#definedtermset"}}, {"@type": "DefinedTerm", "url": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#watt-hour", "inDefinedTermSet": {"@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#definedtermset"}}, {"@type": "DefinedTerm", "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#weatherization", "inDefinedTermSet": {"@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#definedtermset"}}, {"@type": "DefinedTerm", "@id": "url": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#weibull", "inDefinedTermSet": {"@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#definedtermset"}}, {"@type": "DefinedTerm", "@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#wacc", "name": "Weighted average cost of capital (WACC)", "description": "The blended return a project must pay its lenders and its owners, used as the project's discount rate.", "url": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#wacc", "inDefinedTermSet": {"@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#definedtermset"}}, {"@type": "DefinedTerm", "@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#weighted-overlay", "name": "Weighted overlay", "description": "Combining several criterion maps cell by cell: each "inDefinedTermSet": {"@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#definedtermset"}}, {"@type": "DefinedTerm", "@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#weighted-sum", "name": "Weighted sum", "description": "A way to combine several goals into one score by adding them up, each multiplied by a weight.", "url": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#weighted-sum", "inDefinedTermSet": {"@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#definedtermset"}}, {"@type": "DefinedTerm", "@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#well-to-gate", "name": "Well-to-gate", "description": "An emissions boundary from producing the inputs, such as gas or electricity, to hydrogen leaving the plant; delivery and use are outside it.", "url": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#well-to-gate", "inDefinedTermSet": {"@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#definedtermset"}}, {"@type": "DefinedTerm", "@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#wet-bulb-temperature", "name": "Wet-bulb "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#definedtermset"}}, {"@type": "DefinedTerm", "@id": "https://henryutd2021.github.io/learn/glossary.html#wholesale-price", "name": "Wholesale price",
